title: CCC Math: A Structural Algebra for DBM-SI, Autonomous AI Coding, and Recursive Structural Intelligence
description: Universal Typing/Naming (UTN) is a foundational structural intelligence infrastructure for DBM-SI systems. Unlike traditional naming conventions or type systems, UTN treats names and types as emergent structural identities constrained by CCC invariants, recursive structural roles, metric consistency, behavioral persistence, and Active CCC evolution. This repository introduces: 1) Structural Identity Persistence; 2) CCC-first reverse naming construction; 3) Intent → CCC → Role → Type → Name pipeline; 4) UTN as DBM-SI Structural Identity Layer; 5) Recursive identity alignment; 6) Metric-consistent structural addressing; 7) UTN integration with Calling Graph systems; 8) Active CCC and CAIG integration. UTN reframes naming and typing from symbolic annotation problems into structural intelligence problems. The repository establishes UTN as an independent Delta DOI track intended to accelerate collective learning and recursive structural intelligence research.
